mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AI_EVAL_RUN (RUN_ID, BATCH_ID, CASE_ID, AGENT_ID, AGENT_VERSION, MODEL, PARAMS_JSON, STATUS, REQUESTED_BY, OWNER_INSTANCE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{runId}, #{batchId}, #{caseId}, #{agentId}, #{agentVersion}, #{model}, CAST(#{paramsJson} AS JSONB), 'QUEUED', #{requestedBy}, #{ownerInstance}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE AI_EVAL_RUN SET STATUS = 'FAILED' , FAILURE = '엔진이 다시 떠서 이 평가는 끝나지 못했습니다.' , FINISHED_AT = now() WHERE STATUS IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND OWNER_INSTANCE LIKE #{hostPrefix} AND OWNER_INSTANCE <> #{ownerInstance}
mapper.sql: SELECT RUN_ID AS "runId" , BATCH_ID AS "batchId" , CASE_ID AS "caseId" , AGENT_ID AS "agentId" , AGENT_VERSION AS "agentVersion" , MODEL AS "model" , PARAMS_JSON::TEXT AS "paramsJson" , STATUS AS "status" , PASSED AS "passed" , TOTAL AS "total" , FAILURE AS "failure" , DURATION_MS AS "durationMs" , ROUNDS AS "rounds" , TOOL_CALLS AS "toolCalls" , TOOLS_JSON::TEXT AS "toolsJson" , PROMPT_TOKENS AS "promptTokens" , COMPLETION_TOKENS AS "completionTokens" , WORK_DIR AS "workDir" , ANSWER_JSON->'workflowRun'->>'executionId' AS "executionId" , ANSWER_JSON->'workflowRun'->>'stoppedAt' AS "stoppedAt" , CAST(ANSWER_JSON->'workflowRun'->'snapshot'->>'passed' AS INT) AS "snapshotPassed" , CAST(ANSWER_JSON->'workflowRun'->'snapshot'->>'total' AS INT) AS "snapshotTotal" , REQUESTED_BY AS "requestedBy" , CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" , STARTED_AT AS "startedAt" , FINISHED_AT AS "finishedAt"
mapper.select: , CHECKS_JSON::TEXT AS "checksJson" , ANSWER_JSON::TEXT AS "answerJson" FROM AI_EVAL_RUN WHERE RUN_ID = #{runId}
